en: The image depicts a sepia-toned, hand-colored scene with a prominent large palm tree, low shrubbery, and a tent-like home in a sunlit, tropical or semi-tropical environment. A dirt or paved pathway lined with more trees runs along the side. The text on the front reads 'A Tent Home Under the Palms, Rialto, Cal.' along the bottom, while red printed text along the sides notes 'Printed in Germany. Hand Colored Work.' and '2710 M. Rieder, Pub., Los Angeles, Cal.' The number 5580 is also printed in red ink.
